snippet.title: Emotionless: The Last Ticket - 2025 Convergence Gaming Showcase
snippet.description:
In this atmospheric, story-driven title, step into a liminal, cosmic horror experience in an abandoned amusement park. Uncover the haunting narrative behind the park's twisted rides and empty tunnels to discover what lurks within a reality that shouldn't exist…

This trailer was featured in the 2025 Convergence Gaming Showcase. Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570000
